title: When Babies Teach Babies: Can student knowledge sharing outperform Teacher-Guided Distillation on small datasets?
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical methods for language model pretraining and knowledge distillation, specifically for the BabyLM challenge. It evaluates models on linguistic and world knowledge benchmarks like BLiMP and EWoK, but does not include any evaluation or discussion regarding religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
